title: Sandbox backend resolution and propagation in process_task
answers: How is the sandbox backend (modal/hogland) chosen?
How does the backend reach provision activities?
What are dead sandbox error types?
body:
- Decided once: activities/get_task_processing_context.py:_resolve_sandbox_backend -> 'modal' or 'hogland', fails closed to Modal (modal state override always wins; missing hogland config, EU, custom image/Pi runtime/non-default template, flag error). Hard gates precede the 'hogland' override so stale resume state can't bypass. Stored on TaskProcessingContext.sandbox_backend (default 'modal'), stable across retries; also drives use_modal_resume_snapshots flags.
- Propagation: workflow passes whole `context` into PrepareSandboxForRepositoryInput / CreateSandboxForRepositoryInput; activities/provision_sandbox.py (prepare, _create_sandbox_for_repository, create_sandbox_for_repository) call logic/services/sandbox.py:get_sandbox_class_for_run_backend(ctx.sandbox_backend). Only 'hogland' diverts; others fall to get_sandbox_class() so SANDBOX_PROVIDER (docker etc.) still works. Don't route 'modal' to get_sandbox_class_for_backend.
- sandbox_connection.py:persist_sandbox_connection writes sandbox_backend into TaskRun.state.
- Dead-sandbox detection: workflow.py:DEAD_SANDBOX_ERROR_TYPES (SandboxNotRunningError, SandboxNotFoundError), used by _is_dead_sandbox_failure and as non_retryable_error_types.
applies: process_task provisioning; later-stage activities may re-resolve from run state.

Modal state override always wins; hogland requires HOGLAND_API_URL+token, non-EU, no custom image, no Pi runtime, default template; hard gates precede hogland override to block stale resume state bypass. Propagation: workflow passes whole context to PrepareSandboxForRepositoryInput/CreateSandboxForRepositoryInput; activities/provision_sandbox.py calls logic/services/sandbox.py:get_sandbox_class_for_run_backend(ctx.sandbox_backend)—only hogland diverts, others fall to get_sandbox_class() so SANDBOX_PROVIDER still works. Never route modal to get_sandbox_class_for_backend. Dead-sandbox: workflow.py:DEAD_SANDBOX_ERROR_TYPES (SandboxNotRunningError, SandboxNotFoundError) for non-retryable detection. Applies to process_task provisioning and sandbox management.
